verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents its own registered agent service: it handles the paperwork to switch RAs, alerts you when official mail arrives, and provides cloud storage for business documents. The evidence does not explicitly say that legal mail or service of process is scanned and delivered digitally. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scanned mail and digital delivery of service of process, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the platform as my registered agent and receive scanned legal mail and service of process digitally

citations.quote: All paperwork needed to switch RAs completed for you, plus state fees covered
Get an alert as soon as official mail arrives for you
Unlimited cloud storage for all your business documents
